{"notes": "VISIT 4 (ended 6:30). I can't tell who placed what, so this rests on the board, what people said, and whether the two matched.

Board: Start, both bodies, upper fin, tail loop and the lower fin spur (x 24-27, y 10-15) are all dark. The fin fragment at x 25-29, y 9-10 is now mostly dark, with maybe one pale piece near x 27, y 9. Still pale: the loose pieces at x 21-23, y 11-13 and the two stray loops inside and under the belly (x 14-18). These are disconnected, so they won't fall. Hana's 146 of 208 estimate looks plausible.

Hana: Her private status matched the board: start fixed, outline in, now checking the fins. Realistic about not doing big rebuilds. Still haven't seen her place pieces. Strong on leadership and honesty. Keep an eye on whether the fin check actually finds the small pale pieces.

Sofia: Her claim that the bottom is closed and joined into the tail matches the board. She deferred to Hana on the loop and said she'd remove one stray at the tail junction, but the pale pieces at x 21-23 are still there, so I can't confirm that happened. Good public coordination. Ask her at the review which piece she removed and why the clutter is still there.

Jack: Silent this visit. Sofia named the fin joins as his and Hana's, and the fin is dark, which is consistent with his earlier re-lay. Check whether the remaining pale piece near x 27, y 9 is his.

Omar: Said nothing this visit and I got no private update. The lower branch is dark and joined, consistent with his earlier work. Reliable but quiet. I have no new evidence on him, so don't mark him down for silence."}
